newsitem.title: ROMANIA: FIRST TIER SEND BUCHAREST BOURSE TURNOVER UP.
newsitem.headline: FIRST TIER SEND BUCHAREST BOURSE TURNOVER UP.

text.p: Turnover on the Bucharest
bourse drifted higher to 2.7 billion lei on Tuesday from 2.0
billion at its previous session, as orders accumulated over the
weekend, brokers said.
Tuesday's trading was again dominated by first-tier
listings Azomures SA fertiliser maker and chemical
plant Oltchim SA , which took 89 percent of turnover.
Oltchim traded more than 1.0 million shares, closing flat
at 1,400 lei, while Azomures had 929.1 million lei in turnover,
adding 150 lei to end stronger at 1,510.
Traders said they expected the "buying fury" to calm down
on the first tier for a time as investors were waiting for
fresh data after annual shareholders meetings early in April.
Thin investor interest in the second-tier, which lists 24
stocks, sent most prices lower. Three small-caps had no trade.
Policolor SA dye maker, textile plant Dorobantul and Carbid-Fox SA carbide maker were the
most active second-tier listings.
Two unofficial indices -- the VAB and the BIG -- rose from
the previous session by one percent and 1.1 percent
respectively. The BIG first-tier index was 1,602.43 points,
3.22 percent up on the previous session. Its base is 1,000
points.
